skillset.skill: 13s CT - 3000% Light DMG (PHY). For 10s, increase own ATK by 20% and Arts by 2/s.
skillset.arts: 17000% Light DMG (PHY). Increase allies' Arts by 30. For 20s, increase allies' DMG RES by 20% and Human allies' DMG RES by 20%.
skillset.truearts: 150000% Light DMG (PHY). From the second activation of True Arts onwards, permanently adds an additional 50000% to True Arts' DMG Multiplier (MAX: 200000% additional).
skillset.superarts: 200000% Light DMG (PHY). For 50s, reduce enemies' PHY RES and CRI RES by 100%.

passive.ability1: Increase Human allies' Status ailment RES (except Faint) by 50%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: Increase own Arts by 4/s when above 80% HP.
passive.ability3: Increase own ATK by 30% when above 80% HP.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Enjin's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Enjin's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.name: Umbreaker
trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 6000% Light DMG (PHY). For 10s, increase own Light DMG by 60%. Additionally if used for the first time, increase own Arts by 50.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Enjin, increase own Arts by 2/s and CRI DMG by 50%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: Increase own DMG by 10% against enemies in BREAK.
